root_cause: Due retention and storage reclaim ran ahead of SQL verification/capture recovery/continuity within every shared 2000ms callback scope; maintenance work could consume the parent before continuity ever ran.
baseline_reproduction: Actual R74 AutoFetchService callback with injected 650ms retention + 1500ms reclaim records [RETENTION,RECLAIM] and yields before continuity.
fix: Persistent app_state r75_research_callback_turn rotates continuity/retention/continuity/reclaim, committed before work. Maintenance callbacks return through same finally; existing handler posts one 500ms continuation after maintenance even if no pending lane is visible. Due/cadence checks retained. Non-due maintenance slots run continuity. Parent 2000ms / continuity child 1000ms unchanged.
limitations: Only maintenance/training collaborator work is injected; trainer performance or device callback timing is not certified by this fixture.
Required schema startup and runtime SQL verification still run inside the same 2000ms parent scope.
Android process/OEM suspension and external source timing require physical device observation.
